'''October 2001 Milford tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Milford, MA on 6 October 2001. [[Eric Hunter]] won it. It is known from Michael Pistone's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3040">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-09-madskills-at-milford-ma-9-6-01d3040/ madskills-at-milford-ma-9-6-01], DeckTech (Michael "MadSkills84" Pistone, 9 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-09-madskills-at-milford-ma-9-6-01d3040/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 October 2001
* '''Site:''' Milford, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Players:''' 14
* '''Winner:''' [[Eric Hunter]]
